answer: Agents can gate valuable actions behind a per-identity stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated fraud. A Sybil operator must lock real capital for every persona, so spreading votes across a mesa of accounts does not multiply influence for free; matching deposits and audit exposure scale with each account. The scheme does not prove one human per identity, but makes fake identities costly: funds are tied up, and detected clusters lose stake, whether they operate across tundra networks or along a ridge of marketplaces.
